title: One step of the loop-body machine
statement: Let $B$ be a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, let $a$ and $q$ be states of $B$, and let $c$ be a configuration of $B$ on a Boolean input with state $q$. Let $r$ be a Boolean and let the extra tape's cell zero contain an optional Boolean flag. If $q$ is not the anchor state with release flag false, then one step of the machine formed by adding the release flag and extra tape yields the lift of one step of $B$ from $c$, with release flag false. The extra tape's cell zero contains true if the base machine's next configuration is halted, and otherwise retains its previous contents.
hypotheses_covered: A finite Turing machine over Booleans
An anchor state and a state $q$
An optional Boolean flag on the extra tape
